groups.title: People
groups.note: Every person who authored or committed a commit on main, shown by GitHub login, plus the project owner.

members.name: MosheByte
members.role: Owner: sets direction, holds the accounts. Commits through this account are written by the agent and disclosed in their trailers.

groups.title: Agents
groups.note: Agents have no GitHub account of their own here. They act through the owner's account, and every commit they write names them in a Co-Authored-By trailer; the counts come from those trailers.

members.name: Claude Opus 5.5
members.role: Engineering: writes the code, docs and infrastructure; co-author of every commit it touches

groups.title: Bots and automation
groups.note: Every GitHub App, bot and workflow that acts on the repository, what it does, and the commits on main it authored. A squash merge counts for the pull request's author.

members.name: CodeQL
members.role: Code scanning with CodeQL (codeql.yml) for Actions workflows, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust.

members.name: Dependabot
members.role: Opens dependency update pull requests for Cargo, npm, GitHub Actions and pip (.github/dependabot.yml). They merge through the merge queue once ci-ok passes (deps-automerge.yml).

members.name: GitHub Actions
members.role: Runs the workflows in .github/workflows: nightly board, cflite-batch, cflite-pr, CI, CodeQL, this list, site deploy, dependency auto-merge, devcontainer, harness, infra apply, PR labels, GitLab mirror, nightly, API docs, rule proposal issues, publish, red mod intake, Scorecard, stale sweep and first pull request comments. Commits as github-actions[bot] through bot pull requests (tools/bot_pr.sh): the nightly refresh of this list (contributors.yml).

members.name: jarrow-bot (deploy key)
members.role: SSH deploy key with write access. Actions pushes jarrow-bot commits with it, directly for LEDGER and board-data commits (board.yml).

members.name: Renovate
members.role: Opens dependency update pull requests for Docker base images, Gradle plugins and libraries, the Rust toolchain and versions its regex managers find in other files (renovate.json). They merge through the merge queue once ci-ok passes (deps-automerge.yml).
